concrete_capability_transition: CLI status-only runtime transport -> brownie inspect task, brownie inspect run, and brownie list tasks invoke fixed existing Rust runtime read-only inspection methods with bounded human and JSON output

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes runtime-owned task/run progress inspectable from the official CLI without forcing callers through raw JSON-RPC names or VSIX-only surfaces.
Allows headless callers and humans to inspect existing tasks and runs before CLI run/resume execution slices are added.
Keeps read-only task/run/list semantics inside the Rust runtime and keeps the CLI limited to fixed command-to-method transport and bounded rendering.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances progress_visualization with headless_autonomous_development support by exposing fixed read-only task/run/list inspection commands through the existing Rust runtime authority boundary.
answers.new_capability: brownie inspect task <task-id>, brownie inspect run <run-id>, and brownie list tasks become executable against brownie-runtime and return bounded human or JSON results.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-2 only reports runtime.status; it cannot inspect a task, run, or task list and therefore cannot help callers decide whether an existing objective is runnable, blocked, or terminal.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: CLI Product DoD gap CLI-3 remains open, leaving the CLI without read-only progress inspection before autonomous run/resume slices.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from CLI-1 parser/binary work and CLI-2 runtime.status transport; this phase connects three already parsed read-only workflow commands to existing runtime inspection methods.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation uses existing task.inspect, run.inspect, and task.list runtime methods and adds no runtime JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It renders selected bounded fields from runtime-owned responses and adds no report, readiness, diagnostics wrapper, history, digest, verdict, preview, or summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime semantics are unchanged; user-visible CLI behavior changes from unsupported inspect/list commands to real bounded read-only runtime invocations.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless callers can inspect runtime-owned progress state from the primary CLI before deciding whether to run, resume, or wait.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes CLI Product DoD gap CLI-3 only and leaves CLI-4 through CLI-10 open for bounded follow-up phases.

exit_criteria: brownie inspect task <task-id> invokes task.inspect with params {task_id} and succeeds on a valid runtime response
brownie inspect run <run-id> invokes run.inspect with params {run_id} and succeeds on a valid runtime response
brownie list tasks invokes task.list with no params and succeeds on a valid runtime response
JSON-RPC version, response id, result/error exclusivity, and required result shape are validated for read-only inspection calls
human output is bounded and selected, not a raw runtime transport dump
--json output is bounded and names the selected CLI result, not a generic RPC response
runtime errors, malformed responses, mismatched ids, missing binary, and timeouts fail closed without exposing runtime payloads, paths, environment, stdout/stderr, prompts, file contents, or secrets
brownie run remains nonexecuting in CLI-3
develop remains absent as a primary command
no runtime JSON-RPC method is added for this phase

brownie-cli integration tests cover bounded human output and JSON output for read-only inspection commands.

accepted_capability: brownie inspect task, brownie inspect run, and brownie list tasks now use the thin fail-closed stdio JSON-RPC transport to call existing Rust runtime read-only methods.
The CLI validates JSON-RPC envelopes and required response shape before printing selected bounded progress information.
behavior_evidence: Integration tests use fake runtime processes to verify task.inspect, run.inspect, and task.list request construction and bounded output behavior.
An integration test invokes the real brownie-runtime binary for brownie list tasks when the workspace binary is available.
cargo fmt --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo test --workspace, diagnostics guard, phase-value guard, product-completion guard, and VSIX checks remain required validation.
safety_boundary: CLI-3 adds no runtime JSON-RPC method and exposes no arbitrary JSON-RPC passthrough.
CLI-3 does not implement brownie run execution, resume execution, a CLI-owned scheduler, or a second agent loop.
CLI-3 does not duplicate permission, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, product-completion, workspace mutation, ledger, provider, verifier, or agent-loop policy in the CLI.
CLI-3 does not expose raw prompts, provider responses, file contents, stdout/stderr payloads, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, or secrets.
non_goals: No resume runtime behavior, mode-list runtime behavior, daemon lifecycle manager, TUI, REPL, shell integration, plugin system, or packaging release.
No workspace mutation, provider execution, controlled tool execution, verifier execution, network access, git execution, or service control.
No generic inspect wrapper, RPC mirror, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, preview, or summary surface.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected arbitrary JSON-RPC passthrough because the CLI must expose fixed workflow commands, not a raw RPC mirror.
Rejected adding new runtime RPC methods because existing task.inspect, run.inspect, and task.list already own the read-only semantics.
Rejected implementing brownie run or resume in this phase because that would mix CLI-4/CLI-5 execution work into CLI-3.
Rejected CLI-owned interpretation of permissions, replay, recovery, Mode Pack, Product DoD, workspace mutation, and next-action policy because Rust runtime authority remains invariant.
technical_debt: CLI-4 through CLI-10 remain open Product DoD gaps after CLI-3.
Runtime binary discovery and packaging can be hardened in CLI-8 without changing CLI-3 read-only transport authority semantics.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-3 lands, CLI-4 should add the first bounded brownie run objective submission path while keeping execution decisions in Rust.
Product completion is denied until all required CLI Product DoD gaps, blocking debt, and required_before_release debt are closed.
